```{r setup}
library(bioRtools)
library(ggplot2)
```

`theme_prism()` provides a publication-oriented base theme that remains
composable with ordinary `ggplot2` theme elements.

```{r}
p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Species, Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_wong() +
  theme_prism()

p
```
